title: Mariano's collector 1.8.0rc5 walkthrough, part 3: the delivered release, offline (recorded 2026-11-02)

say: Mariano's collector: walkthrough, PART 3 (recorded 2026-11-02 on Hamza's workstation, Windows 11, NOT on the
client's VM). Every command runs for real while it is recorded; nothing is typed in afterwards.
Parts 1 and 2 recorded the live run Q2 (01M6E5V6CASQ8F00VC8PE9TFYW) on release 1.8.0rc4 at Vernon Hills Pickup.
Q2 was rejected by two gates: G3 (Cat Food: 231 of the 232 products the site reports) and G13 (integrity).
The G13 rejection was a defect of ours: two fetches of a page that Oxylabs never delivered (HTTP 500 on every
attempt, not charged) were counted as unverified pages, although no record depends on them.
This part shows the DELIVERED release, 1.8.0rc5, which fixes that, OFFLINE: no request is sent to Mariano's or
to any provider. 1.8.0rc5 HAS NOT RUN LIVE: its first live run is still pending, and so is the client's full
category list (only CSV rows 22-27 were collected, as a qualification scope).

steps.cmd: sha256sum MARIANOS_SOURCE_1.8.0rc5.zip; marianos-collector --version (from its clean extraction)
argv: cd /c/m6/pkg185 && sha256sum MARIANOS_SOURCE_1.8.0rc5.zip && /c/x19/MARIANOS_SOURCE_1.8.0rc5/source/.venv/Scripts/marianos-collector.exe --version && git -C C:/m5/wt log -1 --format='commit %H%n%s'
git -C C:/m5/wt diff --stat 9d16475 ee5ec99 -- headless/marianos-azure-headless/src headless/marianos-azure-headless/tests headless/marianos-azure-headless/pyproject.toml

say: The rule now: every page the run stored must still match its recorded SHA-256, as before. A fetch that brought
no page fails G13 only if a product, offer, placement or listing-page row of the run, or a record's provenance,
names it as a source. The two regressions below run on 1.8.0rc5 from the clean extraction of its archive, on
a disposable test database.

steps.cmd: pytest tests/integration/test_listing_pages.py -k "never_brought or depends_on" (1.8.0rc5, clean extraction)
argv: bash /c/m6/tools/t2.sh /c/x19/MARIANOS_SOURCE_1.8.0rc5/source marianos_test_walk3 -p no:randomly tests/integration/test_listing_pages.py -k 'never_brought or depends_on' -v 2>&1 | grep -E 'PASSED|FAILED|ERROR|passed|failed'

steps.cmd: the same two tests on 1.8.0rc4 (saved before the commit, 14:19Z)

say: And on the real qualification database (read only): G13's integrity reading of the four live runs, computed
by each release's own code. 1.8.0rc4 reports Q2's page hashes as not verified; 1.8.0rc5 verifies them. Q1, Q1b
and Q1c read the same under both.

steps.cmd: the full suite of 1.8.0rc5 from the clean extraction (its summary line)

say: Not shown here, and not done:
- 1.8.0rc5 has not run live; Q2's live evidence is from 1.8.0rc4 (parts 1 and 2);
- the client's full category list (28 rows) has not been collected at Vernon Hills; rows 22-27 only;
- the Oxylabs Classic probe has never sent a request: its live mode is disabled pending approval;
- the checks on the client's VM have not been executed (no access before its scheduled shutdown).
End of the walkthrough (part 3 of 3).
